pr.title: feat(conport): close JSON-RPC discovery gaps and fix SSE transport URL
pr.body:
Closes three JSON-RPC discovery gaps and one transport mis-advertisement:
1. Adds `conport_workspace_summary` to enhanced_server.py dispatch_map so the tool is reachable via JSON-RPC.
2. Adds schema entries for `fork_instance`, `promote`, and `promote_all` to _get_tool_schemas (documented admin-only, schemas only).
3. Fixes info_server.py advertised SSE URL from :3004 to :3005.
4. Adds `EXPOSE 3005` to Dockerfile.

Depends on DMX-CONPORT-OPTIMAL-104 and DMX-CONPORT-OPTIMAL-105 (all 13 tools must exist before parity can be verified).

Acceptance: tools/list advertises 13 tools including workspace_summary.

When ag_catalog is absent OR schema_migrations is absent or empty, the /health JSON response MUST include a 'graph' key set to 'degraded'. When both checks pass, 'graph' should be 'ok'. The HTTP status code may remain 200 but the 'graph' field must distinguish the two states. Add a corresponding test in test_jsonrpc_parity.py that asserts 'graph' key is present in /health response.
